pages.title: Overview
pages.description: Etchv watermarking API docs. Add an invisible watermark to images and videos, or watermark PDFs, then detect it to match each copy to your records.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.description: Watermarking API quickstart: set an API key, embed an invisible watermark in an image, save the watermark ID, then detect the watermark in a copy.

pages.title: Authentication
pages.description: Create an Etchv API key with only the permissions your integration needs, keep it on your server, and fix common API authentication errors.

pages.title: Plans and credits
pages.description: Etchv watermarking plans and credits: the 7-day free trial, which formats each plan includes, what uses credits, rate limits and how to cancel.

pages.title: MCP server
pages.description: Use the Etchv MCP server to watermark files, detect watermarks and manage assets from your AI assistant. It runs locally over stdio with your API key.

pages.title: Automate with Etchv
pages.description: Automate invisible watermarking with Zapier, n8n and Make. Each connector embeds or detects watermarks and collects results. Early access by invitation.

pages.title: Zapier
pages.description: Add invisible watermarking and watermark detection to a Zap. Connect your Etchv account, watermark a file and see how files and retries work.

pages.title: n8n
pages.description: Add invisible watermarking and watermark detection to an n8n workflow with the Etchv community node. Add your API key, then build the workflow.

pages.title: Make
pages.description: Add invisible watermarking and watermark detection to a Make scenario. Connect your Etchv account, then add modules to submit jobs and collect results.

pages.title: Sync and async
pages.description: Watermark files synchronously or asynchronously with the Etchv API. Wait for a result or submit a background job, then poll, use webhooks or retry safely.

pages.title: Large files
pages.description: Upload large files to Etchv once with a signed URL, then watermark them or detect watermarks in delivered files up to 192 MB by upload ID.

pages.title: Webhooks
pages.description: Etchv watermarking webhooks send signed events when a job finishes. Create an HTTPS endpoint, verify each delivery, and inspect or redeliver events.

pages.title: GPU processing
pages.description: Run watermarking and watermark detection on a GPU with accelerator=gpu on Business and Enterprise plans. GPU jobs cost 3x credits; CPU is the default.

pages.title: Embed an image
pages.description: Image watermarking API reference: embed an invisible watermark in an image, keep its original format, and save the watermark ID from the response.

pages.title: Detect a watermark
pages.description: Detect watermark API reference: send an image, read the watermark Etchv finds, and match its watermark ID to your records. Up to 95 MB and 40 MP.

pages.title: PDF watermarking
pages.description: PDF watermarking API reference: watermark PDF pages while keeping text selectable and vector content intact. Pages are not flattened. Up to 20 MB, 8 pages.

pages.title: Video watermarking
pages.description: Video watermarking API reference: add an invisible watermark to every frame of H.264 MP4 and MOV files while keeping supported audio. Up to 20 MB.

pages.title: Asset library
pages.description: Asset library API: list, download, rename and delete your original and watermarked files. Records stay until you delete them; managing them is free.

pages.title: Errors and limits
pages.description: Etchv watermarking API errors and limits: HTTP status codes, rate limits, image upload limits, how credits work when you retry, and service status.

pages.title: Choose your storage
pages.description: Choose where watermarked files are stored: included Etchv storage or your own Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage or Azure bucket, plus retention and deletion.

pages.title: Amazon S3
pages.description: Store watermarked files in your own Amazon S3 bucket. Create a limited cross-account IAM role, add the bucket as a destination, then test it.

pages.title: Google Cloud Storage
pages.description: Store watermarked files in your own Google Cloud Storage bucket. Grant Etchv access without a private key (recommended) or with a service account key.

pages.title: Azure Blob Storage
pages.description: Store watermarked files in your own Azure Blob Storage container. Create a scoped SAS token, connect and verify it, and renew access before it expires.

pages.title: Node.js
pages.description: Node.js watermarking SDK for Etchv. Watermark images, PDFs and videos, detect watermarks, and manage assets from your server. TypeScript types included.

pages.title: Python
pages.description: Python watermarking SDK for Etchv. Watermark images, PDFs and videos, detect watermarks, and manage assets with a fully typed client. Install with pip.

pages.title: Go
